{{short description|Belgian mathematician}}
{{use dmy dates|cs1-dates=ly|date=April 2020}}
'''Simone Gutt''' (born 1956) is a Belgian mathematician specializing in [[differential geometry]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]].{{r|arb}}

==Education and career==
Gutt was born on 13 July 1956 in [[Uccle]], near [[Brussels]].{{r|arb}} She completed her doctorate in 1980 at the Université libre de Bruxelles; her dissertation, ''Déformations formelles de l'algèbre des fonctions différentiables sur une variété symplectique'', was jointly supervised by Michel Cahen and {{ill|Moshé Flato|fr}}.{{r|mg}}

She was a researcher for the [[National Fund for Scientific Research]] from 1981 until 1991, and became a professor at the Université libre de Bruxelles in 1992.{{r|cv}}

==Recognition==
Gutt was the 1998 winner of the quadrennial [[Francois Deruyts Prize]] in geometry of the [[Royal Academies for Science and the Arts of Belgium]].{{r|cv}} She was elected to the [[Royal Academy of Science, Letters and Fine Arts of Belgium]] in 2004.{{r|arb}}
